newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - MOGAS, GAS OIL WEAKEN, NOT FUEL.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - MOGAS, GAS OIL WEAKEN, NOT FUEL.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Friday, except fuel which held steady, dealers said.
Gasoline prompt barges fell $9-$10 as Morgan Stanley's market squeeze was seen coming to an end. Early deals at $216 and $220 for Eurograde were followed by trades at $222 and $223.
Gas oil barges were $3.00 a tonne lower after a drop in IPE futures and narrowly easier differentials. Activity was poor.
High sulphur fuel barges were largely stable after a major bought at $95 fob ARA. Cargoes were unchanged but one seller was offering at $88 fob, a level deemed too high by most buyers.
